description: This file defines functions related to 'template' rules in a build system, including documentation, constants, and the implementation of RunTemplate() which registers templates within a scope.

classes.name: Template
classes.description: Represents a template rule in the build system, encapsulating its scope and definition.

classes.name: Scope
classes.description: Represents a scope in which variables, templates, and other build definitions are stored.

methods.name: RunTemplate
methods.description: Defines a new template in the given scope, ensuring proper registration and handling of errors.
